implementation_scope: Add real type/cost and battlefield-zone persistence for four mana artifacts and three talismans with first-turn artifact tapping (unlike creatures)

Support Brainstorm draw three/put two on top chosen by fixed descending MV/name policy; support Ponder top three original order, never shuffle, then draw one

deterministic_policies.mana_artifact_cast: In replay, sources enter untapped and remain on battlefield. No automatic taps or optimization; test manual tap separately. Next-turn mana still injected, artifact mana contribution therefore cannot be claimed to improve throughput.
deterministic_policies.talisman: Colorless activation has no damage; colored activation deals one damage to pilot, never to opponents; pilot loses at zero or below.
deterministic_policies.brainstorm: Draw 3 known top cards, return 2 cards from hand with largest printed MV (then alphabetical name) to top of library; this is one legal recorded choice, not optimal.
deterministic_policies.ponder: Keep peeked top 3 in their original order, decline optional shuffle, draw first; this is one legal recorded choice, not optimal.
deterministic_policies.cascade_unmodeled: Log name and decline cast; NEVER assign generic favorable proxy. Preserve role/type and detailed hit coverage
deterministic_policies.opponent_response: Same two fixed scenarios as Cycle 97; response patterns are scripted not sampled probabilities.

safety: This is not a complete 99-card gameplay simulation; fixed three-card hand, commander already in play, injected mana, deterministic card choice and no opponent-policies remain.
Only ten additional named card effects fully implemented under specified policies, not unknown effects; omitted targeted choices and spontaneous spells fail closed.
